personality: 7 Dark-First Utility DARK (Modified for Sci-Fi Survival Landscape Game)
personality_one_liner: A gritty, dark neon survival command center—optimized for high-stress, landscape mobile FPS gameplay where every action feels immediate, tactical, and vital.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing for menu layouts to fill landscape space; tight structural spacing for HUD elements to avoid obscuring gameplay. Absolute positioning for HUD, Flexbox for Menus.

do's: Use blur on main menu panels, pause menus, and leaderboard modal so the 3D scene (or background image) remains faintly visible.
Use strong dark tint (>75% opacity) underneath the blur for foreground readability.
Use subtle blur for HUD backdrops (like ammo/health panels) if needed, but solid #1A1D24 is safer for low-end Android.
dont's: Don't blur the touch control joysticks/buttons; they need to be highly visible and performant.
Don't use glassmorphism on the crosshair or critical hit markers.

screens.name: MainMenu
screens.purpose: Entry point for the player, establishing the dark survival atmosphere before diving into the 3D scene.
screens.layout: Landscape Lock. Left 40% of screen: Glass panel containing the Game Title (Rajdhani, oversized, brand colors), Username input field, and stacked primary action buttons (Play, Leaderboard, Settings). Right 60% of screen: Clear view of the dark neon zombie background image with a subtle vignette. Bottom Center: AdMob banner placement container.

screens.name: HUD Overlay
screens.purpose: In-game heads-up display overlaying the Three.js GLView, providing crucial survival stats and tactical touch controls.
screens.layout: Absolute positioning over GLView. Top Left: Segmented Health Bar (Danger Red) + Current Wave number. Top Right: Ammo Counter (Oversized Rajdhani text) + Kill Count + Pause icon. Bottom Left: Virtual Movement Joystick (large hit area, subtle translucent track). Bottom Right: Combat Controls arc (Fire button is largest in corner, bordered in Toxic Green; Jump and Reload sit slightly above/left of Fire). Center: Minimal crosshair, hit marker overlay.

screens.name: GameOver
screens.purpose: High-impact screen showing final survival stats and pushing leaderboard engagement/ad monetization.

states.loading: Subtle loading spinner during score submission.
states.error: Error message with 'Retry Submission' button if network fails.

screens.layout: Full-screen dark translucent overlay over the paused/dead 3D scene. Center column: 'YOU DIED' or 'GAME OVER' in massive red Rajdhani text. Below it: Wave reached, Final Score, High Score. Row of actions: 'Watch Ad to Revive' (brandPrimary button), 'Submit to Leaderboard', 'Main Menu'. AdMob banner at the bottom.

screens.name: Leaderboard
screens.purpose: Ranked list of survivors, emphasizing competition and social proof.

states.loading: Skeleton rows spanning the width of the modal.
states.empty: No survivors yet. Be the first.
states.error: Could not fetch rankings. Retry button.

screens.layout: Centered glass modal (width: 70% of landscape screen). Header: 'TOP SURVIVORS' + Close button. Body: FlatList of rows (Rank, Pseudo, Score, Wave). The player's own row should be highlighted with surfaceTertiary background and brand (Toxic Green) text.

screens.name: Settings
screens.purpose: Control touch sensitivity and audio settings.
screens.layout: Centered glass modal. Sliders for 'Look Sensitivity' and 'Movement Sensitivity' using brand colors. Toggles for 'Sound Effects' and 'Music'. Back button at top left.

instructions_to_main_agent: ORIENTATION: Force the app to landscape mode in app.json and via expo-screen-orientation.

HUD LAYER: The HUD must be an absolute positioned layer on top of the GLView (Three.js canvas). Ensure pointerEvents='box-none' on the HUD container so touches pass through to the 3D scene where there are no UI buttons.

TOUCH CONTROLS: Follow the 2026 FPS standard. Left lower quadrant: Virtual joystick. Right lower quadrant: Fire, Jump, Reload buttons. Ensure touch targets are massive (min 48x48, ideally larger for action buttons).

AESTHETIC: Strictly stick to the Dark-First Utility theme. Use deep obsidian (#0D0F12) for backgrounds/panels, and Toxic Neon Green (#39FF14) and Danger Red (#FF003C) for stats, health, and accents. This fits the 'Neon Protocol' sci-fi survival vibe.

TYPOGRAPHY: Use 'Rajdhani' for all HUD numbers (Ammo, Score, Wave) and Main Menu headers. It gives the exact sci-fi military HUD look requested. Use 'IBM Plex Sans' for smaller UI labels and leaderboard names.
AD PLATFORM: Integrate AdMob banner at the bottom of the Main Menu and Game Over screens. Add a 'Watch Ad to Revive' rewarded ad button on the Game Over screen.

LEARNINGS FROM RESEARCH: In mobile FPS, players expect movement on the left and camera/actions on the right. Group the combat buttons (Fire, Reload, Jump) in an arc accessible by the right thumb. Safe areas are critical in landscape mode—do not place buttons in the extreme corners where notches/bezels might block them.
